title: Fix Puzzle 2d Duplicate Import
description: Fix duplicate import of puzzle2dFixtureMergedKindCatalogs in playground renderer react index.tsx causing vite/babel build error for puzzle-2d entry.
summary: Removed duplicate `puzzle2dFixtureMergedKindCatalogs` import from the `@puzzle/2d` import block in playground renderer react index.tsx. The symbol was listed twice (lines 1812 and 1818), causing Babel "Identifier has already been declared" when loading the puzzle-2d playground entry. Playground renderer react tests pass (16/16).
